# intrebit

> Software development agency based in the EU. Custom software, infrastructure, and consulting.

## About

intrebit builds custom software for businesses. We handle architecture, code, and deployment — you run the business.

Clear thinking over corporate performance. Few clients, direct communication. Europe-based, timezone-flexible.

## Services

### Build
Custom software built for how you actually work. Websites, internal tools, customer portals, mobile apps. We handle the architecture, the code, and the deployment.

### Fix
Broken systems, slow sites, inherited messes. Something's not working and nobody knows why? We dig in, find the root cause, and make it reliable.

### Automate
Turn repetitive tasks into background processes. Data entry, report generation, invoice handling — if you're doing it twice a week, we can probably make it run itself.

## Pricing

- Free: EUR 0 — 2 users, 100 contacts, 4 modules, community support
- Pro: EUR 19/user/mo — 10 users, 5,000 contacts, 10 modules, email support, API access
- Enterprise: EUR 49/user/mo — unlimited users and contacts, all 14 modules, priority support, webhooks, white-label

## Location

EU-based. Data hosted in Germany. GDPR-compliant.
